caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a female figure standing upright on a rectangular platform with four wheels, one at each corner. The figure is dressed in a long, pleated skirt that reaches the ankles, with a multi-layered over-garment featuring a vest-like top and long sleeves. The color palette includes various shades of brown, with accents of red, yellow, green, and blue dispersed throughout the garments, along with signs of wear and fading. The figure's head is adorned with a tall, elaborate headdress consisting of layered, cloth-like elements and a crown structure, from which long, draped fabric falls over the shoulders. The face is detailed, with visible facial features, and the hands rest on the torso, the right hand on the waist and the left hand draped across the front of the body. The platform shows a wood texture, cracks, and metallic wheels, indicating it is a movable base. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Cigar Store Figure
